name: readex
description: Readex: gestão de leituras pessoais (monorepo Vue 3 + Fastify)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run db -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
